title: Security assurance overlay

any: authentication, authorization, tenant, secret, sensitive data, external write, or tool permission changes
a new trust boundary or abuse path is introduced

skill_calls.when: design or architecture risk exists before implementation
authentication, session, role, or tenant behavior changes

nodes.obligation: Review trust boundaries and execute applicable authorization, isolation, abuse, or secret-handling probes.

tests.evidence: backend enforcement and affected trust boundaries have explicit results
tests.command_source: target security tests and review tooling

workline_policy: Attach as an overlay; split only for independent ownership, restricted access, separate writes, or a distinct acceptance gate.
omission_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE only after the impact audit finds no changed trust, permission, identity, tenant, secret, sensitive-data, or external-write boundary.
repair: Security failure reopens the earliest affected design, contract, or implementation fragment and preserves unrelated assurance evidence.
